selected_problem.p: Selective retention: keep therapeutic in CSF while draining fluid

rationale: eShunt creates washout problem. Selective retention solves fundamental conflict.
cerevasc_gap: Published gene therapy delivery but did not address washout in real shunt patients.

all_problems.p: Selective retention: keep therapeutic in CSF while draining fluid

Control spatial distribution of therapeutic via eShunt
